rows.title_short: Billboard and Signage Act of 2005
rows.abstract: \"Billboard and Signage Act of 2005\". The bill lists the prohibitions with regard to the installation of billboards and signages, to wit: a) those that obstruct the view of vehicular or pedestrian traffick; b) those on posts or walls that obstruct roadways and pedestrian lanes; c) those that take the space reserved for safety and informative road signs; d) those that block any rural or urban natural vista; among others.

rows.title_short: National Watershed Management Forum Act of 2005
rows.abstract: \"National Watershed Management Forum Act of 2005\". The measure seeks to institutionalize the National Watershed Management Forum (NWMF) in order to provide a permanent venue for organized discussion on watershed management issues.
